data.name: Laserpunk
data.detailed_description:
Laserpunk is a fast-paced top-down action roguelite where getting stronger isn't the only thing that changes — every round can make your life harder.

Fight through relentless waves of enemies using your laser, shield, and dash while managing limited energy and adapting to increasingly dangerous situations. When the timer runs out, you're forced to choose from a set of Flaws — gameplay-changing disadvantages that stay with you for the next round.

Maybe your laser stops working. Maybe your shield becomes dangerous to use. Maybe your movement is restricted. Each flaw forces you to rethink how you play and survive with what you have.

Take greater risks for greater rewards, challenge yourself for bonus currency, reroll unwanted choices, and build your way through increasingly chaotic encounters.

Features

  • Fast-paced top-down combat built around precise movement and laser-based weapons.

  • Unique Flaw system that changes the rules of the game every round.

  • Risk vs. reward choices — accept harder conditions for better rewards.

  • Laser, shield and dash mechanics with resources that must be carefully managed.

  • Randomized runs where different combinations of flaws create new challenges.

  • Increasingly dangerous enemies that force you to constantly adapt.

  • Cyberpunk pixel-art style packed with lasers, neon and chaos.

  • High replayability with runs that rarely play out the same way twice.

In Laserpunk, survival isn't about becoming unstoppable.

It's about learning how to keep fighting when the game keeps taking things away from you.

data.short_description: Laserpunk is a fast-paced top-down action roguelite where every round forces you to adapt. Blast through waves of enemies with powerful lasers, choose dangerous flaws, build around their weaknesses, and survive as long as you can.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated DirectX 11 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
